findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in Jinja2 internals
 * @description Detects uses of pickle, marshal, or shelve that may deserialize untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jinja2/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation in Jinja2 internals."
findings.hypothesis: Jinja2 may use pickle or similar modules for caching or bytecode storage, which could be unsafe if fed untrusted data.

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation in Jinja2 internals.

/**
 * @name Insecure use of pickle/marshal in Jinja2 internals
 * @description Detects uses of pickle or marshal load/loads in Jinja2 that may deserialize untrusted data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jinja2/unsafe-deserialization-all
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2.bccache").getMember(["load_bytecode", "dump_bytecode"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe (de)serialization operation in Jinja2 internals."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe deserialization via pickle/marshal in Jinja2 internals
